title: Rabbi Ze’ira son of Rabbi Abbahu
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:6, where they said that one does not bless over the lamp until one benefits from its light; Rabbi Ze’ira son of Rabbi Abbahu expounded: “And God saw that it was good,” and afterward “And He separated.” In Bereshit Rabbah 3:6 he expounded in Caesarea; in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1 he spoke in the name of his father Rabbi Abbahu; in Avodah Zarah, chapter 3, end of halakhah 1, the words “Rabbi Abbahu” are missing.

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:6 includes “the light” in its longer verse quotation. Hyman’s supplied abbreviated quotation omits those words; the translation follows the supplied wording.
